meaning: A phone setting that turns off calls, texts, and most wireless signals. It can help on trips and save battery.
clues: It switches off your phone's calls, texts, and most wireless signals, but the phone stays on.
Turning it on and then off again can refresh a weak signal.
Its name has a flying machine in it, and it can help lower extra charges when you travel.
It has two words. The first has eight letters and starts with A.
assumes: Calls still reach a phone that is only silenced
A phone using another network is still connected

decoys.meaning: A setting that silences calls and alerts until you turn it off or its schedule ends.
A setting where the phone does not ring or play alert sounds.
Using another phone network when you are outside your own network's area.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open quick settings (swipe down on Android, or open Control Center on iPhone), tap the airplane, then tap it again to turn it off.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: One tap and the phone stops reaching out. Calm. I like it.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Turn it back off when you want calls and texts again.
